amendment.name: successor-detector-inference-contract
amendment.freeze_policy: Settings frozen after sampled parity and prior paired development audit; canonical full-split certification recorded separately in the Phase 2 completion manifest. Never edit this version in place.

preprocessing.letterbox: released YOLO letterbox(auto=True, scaleup=True, stride=model stride) directly on decoded image
preprocessing.normalization: BGR to RGB CHW, float32 divided by 255
preprocessing.batching: stack only equal-shaped individually prepared images; no padding derived from batch peers

evaluation_aggregation.primary: arithmetic mean of per-sequence EDTC Acc
evaluation_aggregation.frame_weighted: sum(sequence frames * sequence EDTC Acc) / sum(sequence frames)
evaluation_aggregation.pooled_components: separate diagnostic only; not frame-weighted sequence Acc

candidate_selection.exact_anchor_rule: select the highest-scoring eligible flattened anchor directly; for one-class non-merge NMS it is necessarily the highest-scoring survivor

coordinates.uncertainty_normalization: letterboxed detector-input coordinates before scaling or endpoint rounding
coordinates.candidate_box_storage: sensor-native continuous xywh plus detector-input xywh; no endpoint rounding or +1

required_checks: flattened uncertainty anchor count equals prediction anchor count
